response:
Being called names repeatedly is exhausting and hurtful, and it makes sense that you're tired of it. It's especially frustrating when the people criticizing you act the same way—that double standard isn't fair to you.

You don't have to accept name-calling. You can calmly set a boundary, like saying, "I'm not okay with being called that, so I'm going to step away if it continues," and then actually removing yourself from the conversation when it happens. You can't control how others behave, but you can control how much you let their words define you—their name-calling reflects them, not your worth. If this is coming from people you're around a lot, it may help to talk it through with someone you trust who can support you. Do you have anyone like that in your life right now?
